description: List what Clypmint remembers for a brand: its preferences, looks and spellings, each with the id forget takes. Read it to answer "what do you remember?" or before remember, to avoid saying the same thing twice. Cost: Free: no credits.

brand_id.description: Only for an account with several brands: a brand_id from list_memory. Left out, the account's default brand.

name: list_memory

outputSchema.description: Clypmint list_memory result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: List what Clypmint remembers
